claim: Every record in data/external-research/104-source-registry.jsonl that asserts crossref_verified:true corresponds to a DOI that (a) resolves via the public Crossref REST API (HTTP 200), (b) returns a title matching the registry's recorded crossref_title, (c) returns a publication year matching the registry's recorded crossref_year, and (d) is not flagged as retracted or detected as a duplicate.
null_or_comparison: Null/comparison proposition: the registry's own crossref_verified:true assertion is the baseline; the external Crossref record is the independent comparator. A record is 'verified' only if resolution + title-match + year-match + no-retraction + no-duplicate all hold.
scope: All 117 records in 104-source-registry.jsonl. Primary metric computed over the subset asserting crossref_verified:true (expected = all 117).
exclusions: No content/claim assessment of the articles; no assessment of Pointfire physics correctness; DOIs that cannot be parsed from the registry are reported as PARSE_FAILED, not silently dropped.

source_acquisition.licence: Crossref metadata is released under CC0 (public-domain dedication); raw redistribution permitted by Crossref terms.

baseline: The registry's own recorded crossref_verified:true, crossref_title and crossref_year fields (the repository's prior metadata claim).

metrics.primary_metric: verification_match_rate = (#records with resolution AND title_match AND year_match AND no retraction AND no duplicate) / (#records asserting crossref_verified:true)

uncertainty: Finite population N=117 (census, not a sample) so no sampling uncertainty. Measurement uncertainty arises only from title normalization (case/punctuation/whitespace); reported as exact counts and rates. A sensitivity check reports match counts under both strict-normalized equality and loose-containment matching.

null_conditions.description: verification_match_rate < 0.80 but failures are attributable to title-normalization ambiguity or network degradation rather than concrete metadata errors, OR resolution_rate < 0.90 preventing a valid census.

contradiction_conditions.description: verification_match_rate < 0.80 with concrete title/year mismatches indicating the METADATA_VERIFIED tier is not warranted for failing entries.

invalid_test_conditions.description: Crossref entirely unreachable, persistent HTTP 429/403 policy block, or script error preventing any valid query => TEST_INVALID_OR_ABORTED; results are NOT fabricated or substituted.

stopping_rule: All 117 DOIs are attempted. On HTTP 429, bounded exponential backoff retry (max 4 attempts). Persistent block or total network failure => abort and record TEST_INVALID_OR_ABORTED. No early stop on favourable interim counts.

e_axis_mapping.on_supported: Confirm evidence_tier_104=METADATA_VERIFIED for passing entries; no promotion beyond scope; record a positive provenance note.
e_axis_mapping.on_partial: Downgrade failing entries to METADATA_UNCONFIRMED (tier lowered); retain METADATA_VERIFIED for passing entries; record a known-limitation note.
e_axis_mapping.on_null: Retain E0-equivalent (no promotion); record as a known limitation.
e_axis_mapping.on_contradicted: Downgrade failing entries; add a known-limitation note on external-source atlas reliability; propagate to dependent public surfaces.
e_axis_mapping.on_invalid: Retain E0-equivalent; record the blocked acquisition as a known limitation, not a failure of the claim.
